validation.title: Fix these before saving:

validation.retainer_required: A retainer needs its periods and schedule.
validation.tiers_start_at_1: The first slab tier must start at unit 1.
validation.tiers_ascending: Slab tiers must start at increasing units.

validation.tier_pct: Each slab tier needs a percentage.
validation.dates: A rule's end date must be after its start date.
validation.two_decimals: Percentages can have at most two decimals.
validation.unknown_fixed: Recoupment refers to a fixed fee that no longer exists ({detail}).
validation.unknown_rule: A minimum guarantee refers to a commission rule that no longer exists ({detail}).
